        (function () {
            var v3 = false;
            try { v3 = !document.querySelector('link[href*="menu_website3"]'); } catch (e) {}
            /* Purely structural now — the stylesheet already hid the loser. The loser must still
               be REMOVED rather than left hidden, or its directives would compile. Every v2-owned
               element carries `menu-ab-v2`, the announcement bar included (V2/main's `aboveMenu`
               override passes `abClass`); miss one and CZ/HU/RO/ZA/TR/KZ users on a mismatched
               currency would end up with two bars. */
            var doomed = document.querySelectorAll(v3 ? '.menu-ab-v2' : '.menu-ab-v3-host');
            for (var i = 0; i < doomed.length; i++) {
                doomed[i].parentNode.removeChild(doomed[i]);
            }
            /* Resolve v3's `--auth-pending` from the menuData cache the bundle restores at bootstrap
               anyway (MenuDataClientFactory prefix + MenuBasicUserDataEndpointSource key), so repeat
               visitors get the right top bar on first paint. The bundle can't do this sooner: its
               eval and bootstrap are one task, with no paint in between. */
            var nav = v3 && document.querySelector('nav.menu-v3.menu-v3--auth-pending');
            if (nav) {
                try {

|     <script>
|       "
    /* The host app requires gogMenuModule + gogFooterModule, which only the v2 bundle
       registers — so stub them, or the host's bootstrap throws and takes down the whole
       page's Angular, not just the menu. The stubs cannot be empty: hosts inject these two
       services by name.
         - menuChat must be a PROVIDER: the host calls setChatServiceName /
           setDisplayPredicateMethod at config phase, before v3 has bootstrapped.
         - menuNotificationRelatedPageEnter clears bell notifications on page-enter. The live
           instance is in the v3 injector, so bridge to it — a no-op would stop notifications
           clearing with no error anywhere. Add names here if more unpr errors surface. */
    if (window.__gogMenuV3 && window.angular) {
        var ng = window.angular;
        try {
            ng.module('gogMenuModule');
        } catch (e) {
            /* Resolved lazily: v3 has bootstrapped by the time the host calls these on
               navigation. Missing injector / method → safe no-op. */
            var bridgeToV3 = function (serviceName, methods) {
                var lookup = function () {
                    try {
                        var nav = document.querySelector('nav.menu-v3');
                        var injector = nav && ng.element(nav).injector();
                        return injector ? injector.get(serviceName) : null;
                    } catch (err) { return null; }
                };
                var api = {};
                methods.forEach(function (method) {
                    api[method] = function () {
                        var impl = lookup();
                        if (impl && typeof impl[method] === 'function') {
                            return impl[method].apply(impl, arguments);
                        }
                    };
                });
                return api;
            };
            ng.module('gogMenuModule', [])
                .provider('menuChat', function () {
                    this.setChatServiceName = function () {};
                    this.setDisplayPredicateMethod = function () {};
                    this.$get = function () { return {}; };
                })
                .factory('menuNotificationRelatedPageEnter', function () {
                    return bridgeToV3('menuNotificationRelatedPageEnter', [
                        'onWebsiteWishlistEntered',
                        'onWebsiteForumTopicEntered',
                        'onWebsiteGameCardEntered',
                        'onProfilesFeedEntered'
                    ]);
                });
        }
        try { ng.module('gogFooterModule'); } catch (e) { ng.module('gogFooterModule', []); }
    }

    // ── checkout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var PATRONAGE_1_MONTH_PRODUCT_ID = "1954374767";

    function getApiUrl() {
      var env =
        (window.gogData && window.gogData.env) ||
        (window.galaxyInitData && window.galaxyInitData.environment);
      switch (env) {
        case "dev":
        case "staging":
          return "https://api.gog-staging.com";
        case "preprod":
          return "https://api.gog-preprod.com";
        default:
          return "https://api.gog.com";
      }
    }

    function loadToken() {
      return fetch(getApiUrl() + "/user/accessToken.json", {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "include",
      })
        .then(function (res) {
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Token request failed");
          return res.json();
        })
        .then(function (data) {
          window.gogAccessToken = data.accessToken;
          return data.accessToken;
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
          console.error("PP token error:", err);
          return null;
        });
    }

    function preparePatronageCheckout(btn) {
      var apiUrl = getApiUrl();
      if (!window.gogAccessToken) {
        window.galaxyAccounts.openLoginForm();
        return;
      }
      btn.disabled = true;
      var origText = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = t("btn.loading");
      fetch(apiUrl + "/v1/checkout?empty=1", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: "Bearer " + window.gogAccessToken,
        },
      })
        .then(function (res) {
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to create checkout");
          return res.json();
        })
        .then(function (json) {
          var publicOrderId = json.publicOrderId;
          return fetch(
            apiUrl +
              "/v1/checkout/" +
              publicOrderId +
              "/add/" +
              PATRONAGE_1_MONTH_PRODUCT_ID,
            {
              method: "POST",
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                Authorization: "Bearer " + window.gogAccessToken,
              },
            },
          ).then(function (addRes) {
            if (!addRes.ok) throw new Error("Failed to add product");
            var langShortCode =
              window.gogData && window.gogData.locale
                ? window.gogData.locale.split("-")[0]
                : "en";
            window.location.href =
              "/" + langShortCode + "/checkout/" + publicOrderId;
          });
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
          console.error("PP checkout error:", err);
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = origText;
          alert(
            "An error occurred while preparing your checkout. Please try again later.",
          );
        });
    }

    loadToken();

    // ── show modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    window.patronsShowModal = function () {
      if (document.querySelector(".pp-overlay")) return;

      var overlay = document.createElement("div");
      overlay.className = "pp-overlay";
      overlay.innerHTML = html;
      overlay.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
      document.body.appendChild(overlay);
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
      overlay.focus();

      function closeModal() {
        if (document.body.contains(overlay)) {
          document.body.removeChild(overlay);
          document.body.style.overflow = "";
        }
      }

      // ── dataLayer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      function dlPush(eventName) {
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
        window.dataLayer.push({ event: eventName });
      }

      dlPush("patrons_landing_modal_view");

      // ── join button ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      var joinBtn = overlay.querySelector("#pp-btn-join");
      joinBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        dlPush("patrons_landing_modal_cta_join");
        if (window.patronageTracking) {
          window.patronageTracking.trackPatronageButtonClick("pp-btn-join");
        }
        preparePatronageCheckout(joinBtn);
      });

      overlay
        .querySelector("#pp-btn-read")
        .addEventListener("click", function () {
          dlPush("patrons_landing_modal_cta_readmore");
        });

      var MEDAL_SRC =
        "https://images.gog.com/6c153824de83982fde2ceccfcaa2f5ae1f2fccab860c3df0015a5de78a0b8b2b.png";
      var medalCooldown = false;

      function spawnMedals(btn) {
        if (medalCooldown) return;
        medalCooldown = true;
        setTimeout(function () {
          medalCooldown = false;
        }, 800);

        var footer = btn.closest(".pp-footer");
        var footerRect = footer.getBoundingClientRect();
        var rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        var cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2 - footerRect.left;
        var cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2 - footerRect.top;

        for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
          (function (idx) {
            var m = document.createElement("img");
            m.src = MEDAL_SRC;
            var size = 20 + Math.random() * 16;
            m.style.cssText = [
              "position:absolute",
              "width:" + size + "px",
              "height:" + size + "px",
              "left:" + (cx - size / 2) + "px",
              "top:" + (cy - size / 2) + "px",
              "pointer-events:none",
              "z-index:0",
              "border-radius:50%",
              "object-fit:contain",
              "transition:none",
            ].join(";");
            footer.appendChild(m);

            var angle = ((Math.random() * 180 + 180) * Math.PI) / 180; // downward spread
            var speed = 2.4 + Math.random() * 4;
            var vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
            var vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed - 1.6;
            var gravity = 0.12;
            var rotation = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
            var rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
            var x = cx - size / 2;
            var y = cy - size / 2;
            var delay = idx * 40;

            setTimeout(function () {
              function tick() {
                vy += gravity;
                x += vx;
                y += vy;
                rotation += rotSpeed;
                var absX = footerRect.left + x;
                var absY = footerRect.top + y;
                if (
                  absX < -size - 50 ||
                  absX > window.innerWidth + size + 50 ||
                  absY < -size - 50 ||
                  absY > window.innerHeight + size + 50
                ) {
                  if (m.parentNode) m.parentNode.removeChild(m);
                  return;
                }
                m.style.left = x + "px";
                m.style.top = y + "px";
                m.style.transform = "rotate(" + rotation + "deg)";
                requestAnimationFrame(tick);
              }
              requestAnimationFrame(tick);
            }, delay);
          })(i);
        }
      }

      overlay
        .querySelector("#pp-btn-join")
        .addEventListener("mouseenter", function () {
          spawnMedals(this);
        });

      overlay
        .querySelector(".pp-modal__close")
        .addEventListener("click", function () {
          closeModal();
        });
      overlay.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        if (e.target === overlay) closeModal();
      });

      function onKeyDown(e) {
        if (
          (e.key === "Escape" || e.keyCode === 27) &&
          document.body.contains(overlay)
        ) {
          closeModal();
          document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
          overlay.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
        }
      }
      document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
      overlay.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);

      for (var pi = 0; pi < 28; pi++) {
        (function () {
          var p = document.createElement("div");
          p.className = "pp-particle";
          var size = Math.random() * 4 + 2;
          var left = Math.random() * 100;
          var delay = Math.random() * 6;
          var dur = Math.random() * 6 + 5;
          p.style.cssText =
            "width:" +
            size +
            "px;" +
            "height:" +
            size +
            "px;" +
            "left:" +
            left +
            "vw;" +
            "bottom:-" +
            size +
            "px;" +
            "animation-duration:" +
            dur +
            "s;" +
            "animation-delay:" +
            delay +
            "s;" +
            "filter:blur(" +
            (size > 4 ? 1 : 0) +
            "px);" +
            "box-shadow:0 0 " +
            size * 2 +
            "px rgba(212,175,55,0.8);";
          overlay.appendChild(p);
        })();
      }

      function easeOut(t) {
        return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
      }
      function runCountup(el, target, duration) {
        var startTime = null;
        function tick(ts) {
          if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
          var progress = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
          el.textContent = String(Math.round(easeOut(progress) * target)) + "+";
          if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }
      runCountup(overlay.querySelector("#pp-countup-num"), 280, 1800);
      runCountup(overlay.querySelector("#pp-countup-patrons"), 8000, 2200);

      var thunderEl = overlay.querySelector("#pp-thunder");
      var thunderObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
        function (entries) {
          if (!entries[0].isIntersecting) return;
          thunderObserver.disconnect();
          // step 1: fade in as outline
          thunderEl.classList.add("pp-thunder--visible");
          // step 2: blink after 600ms
          setTimeout(function () {
            thunderEl.classList.add("pp-thunder--blinking");
            // step 3: switch to neon after blink completes (~750ms = 3 × 250ms)
            setTimeout(function () {
              thunderEl.classList.remove(
                "pp-thunder--blinking",
                "pp-thunder--outline",
              );
              thunderEl.classList.add("pp-thunder--neon");
            }, 800);
          }, 600);
        },
        { threshold: 0.5 },
      );
      thunderObserver.observe(thunderEl);
    };

    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var triggerBtn =
        e.target.closest(".patrons-section__button") ||
        e.target.closest(".gog-patrons__footer-button") ||
        e.target.closest(".gpp-patrons-widget__cta") ||
        e.target.closest(".multicolumns-section__header-patrons-info");

      if (triggerBtn) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.preventDefault();
        patronsShowModal();
      }
    });

    function bindAngularPatronBtn(el) {
      if (el._patronsBound) return;
      el._patronsBound = true;
      el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.preventDefault();
        patronsShowModal();
      }, true);
    }
    document.querySelectorAll('.gog-patrons-modal__footer-button--primary').forEach(bindAngularPatronBtn);
    new MutationObserver(function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.gog-patrons-modal__footer-button--primary').forEach(bindAngularPatronBtn);
    }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    // ── Catalog badge i18n ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var badgeTranslations = {
      en: "Supported by GOG Patrons",
      pl: "Ze wsparciem Patronów GOG",
      fr: "Soutenu par les GOG Patrons",
      de: "Unterstützt von den GOG Patrons",
    };
    var badgeLang = (
      document.documentElement.lang ||
      navigator.language ||
      "en"
    )
      .split("-")[0]
      .toLowerCase();
    function tBadge() {
      return badgeTranslations[badgeLang] || badgeTranslations["en"];
    }

    // ── Catalog badge ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!document.getElementById("patrons-badge-style")) {
      var badgeStyle = document.createElement("style");
      badgeStyle.id = "patrons-badge-style";
      badgeStyle.textContent = [
        ".patrons-badge span { color: #E5CF82; }",
        '@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) { .patrons-badge span { color: #823c12; } }',
        'html[data-theme="dark"] .patrons-badge span { color: #E5CF82; }',
        'html[data-theme="light"] .patrons-badge span { color: #823c12; }',
      ].join(" ");
      document.head.appendChild(badgeStyle);
    }

    function getGlowColor() {
      const theme = document.documentElement.dataset.theme;
      const isLight =
        theme === "light" ||
        (!theme && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: light)").matches);
      return isLight ? "#823c12" : "#E5CF82";
    }

    function injectCatalogBadge() {
      var wrapper = document.querySelector(
        '[selenium-id="showOnlyPreservedGamesCheckbox"]',
      );
      if (wrapper && !wrapper.dataset.patronsStyled) {
        wrapper.style.marginBottom = "12px";
        wrapper.dataset.patronsStyled = "1";
      }

      document
        .querySelectorAll(
          '[selenium-id="showOnlyPreservedGamesCheckbox"] .filter-option__label',
        )
        .forEach(function (label) {
          if (label.querySelector(".patrons-badge")) return;

          Object.assign(label.style, {
            flexDirection: "column",
            marginRight: "0",
          });

          var badge = document.createElement("div");
          badge.className = "patrons-badge";
          badge.style.cssText =
            "position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;margin-top:4px;";

          var medal = document.createElement("img");
          medal.src =
            "https://images.gog.com/6c153824de83982fde2ceccfcaa2f5ae1f2fccab860c3df0015a5de78a0b8b2b.png";
          medal.style.cssText =
            "width:14px;height:14px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;";

          var text = document.createElement("span");
          text.textContent = tBadge();
          text.style.cssText =
            "font-size:12px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;opacity:0.5;margin-left:4px;";
          text.addEventListener("mouseover", function () {
            var c = getGlowColor();
            this.style.textShadow =
              "0 0 10px " + c + ", 0 0 24px " + c + ", 0 0 40px " + c;
            this.style.opacity = "1";
          });
          text.addEventListener("mouseout", function () {
            this.style.textShadow = "";
            this.style.opacity = "0.5";
          });
          text.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            e.preventDefault();
            patronsShowModal();
          });

          badge.appendChild(medal);
          badge.appendChild(text);
          label.appendChild(badge);
        });
    }

    injectCatalogBadge();

    var catalogBadgeObserver = new MutationObserver(injectCatalogBadge);
    catalogBadgeObserver.observe(document.body, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("PP Error:", e.message, e.stack);
  }
})();
